our_interpretation: The plain reading is that investigating the Nvidia/Huang story and related litigation will provide sustained journalistic work over multiple years. It does not require proof that particular jobs exist solely because of this story.
I interpret 'years' as at least two years after the post, with substantive investigative work continuing through at least November 23, 2028. This minimum duration is my operational threshold.
The phrase specifies a duration, but no latest completion date. I therefore treat this as an open-horizon forecast.
Litigation is part of the predicted sequence, not an explicit condition that must occur before the forecast can be assessed.
criteria.support_condition: Dated investigative reporting or documented journalistic assignments establish sustained work on this story and related litigation across at least two years following November 23, 2026. Routine news repetition or anniversary summaries alone do not qualify.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comprehensive evidence establishes that investigative work on the story and related litigation ended before the minimum two-year duration and did not continue across that period. A sparse search result, a lawsuit ending, or a temporary reporting gap alone is insufficient.
